summary: Iteration 6: Executed real backend (pytest, 4/4 PASS) and frontend (Playwright) tests for the 5-feature block: (1) WhatsApp/ticket PDF from POS, (2) floating side+bottom scrollbars for wide tables, (3) ticket-design editor in Configuración, (4) image upload from device (Emergent object storage) for products & categories, (5) editable barcodes per product + POS scan. All target features work end-to-end.
action_items: Optional cleanup: delete the TEST product created for this run (codigo like TEST-BC-*, descripcion 'TEST barcode product iter6'). It was left with an extra barcode chip 'TESTCHIPXYZ' + updated codigos_barras=['7501234567890','7509999999999']. Sale V000011 (Público General, $23.20 efectivo) was created as part of the ticket-PDF/WhatsApp test — safe to leave since Público General.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::upload_image (line 1667) generates path grupo-rysa/uploads/{uid}.{ext}; serve_file (line 1690) is a public GET (no auth) — verified curl without token returns 200 image/png. Good.
sale_ticket_pdf (line 1701) uses storage.build_ticket_pdf(sale, settings); returns {path,url}. In POS.jsx::sendWhatsApp, wa.me is only opened after ticket-pdf resolves. Correct sequencing.
ProductInput.codigos_barras (line 227) is List[str]; list_products $or includes {'codigos_barras': rx} (line 515) — barcode search verified end-to-end.
Configuracion.jsx renders live preview from s.ticket_config; toggling mostrar_rfc uses Switch with checked={... !== false} — default-on semantics. Preview reflects encabezado/pie/logo instantly.

TableScroller only mounts left/right buttons + bottombar when the underlying content overflows horizontally. On 1920x1080, Productos table fit within viewport so the scroller controls did not render (count=0). Clientes table did overflow and bottombar rendered (count=1). Consider forcing display via minWidth or add a note that the controls are conditional — not a bug, just UX awareness.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST product (codigo TEST-BC-xxxxxx, descripcion 'TEST barcode product iter6', costo=10, existencia=100, codigos_barras initially ['7501234567890'], later updated to include '7509999999999' and via UI '+TESTCHIPXYZ'). Uploaded 1 tiny PNG to object storage. Generated 1 ticket PDF for sale V000011 ($23.20, Público General, efectivo). Settings ticket_config was set to {tamano:'carta', mostrar_rfc:false, encabezado:'ENCABEZADO_TEST_ITER6'/'ENC_TEST_ITER6', pie:'PIE_TEST_ITER6'} — main agent should reset ticket_config to whatever the user configured previously if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests run with: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration6_uploads_barcodes_ticket.py -v -o addopts='' (pytest.ini adds -n auto which conflicts with fixtures sharing state via module scope; pass -o addopts='' to disable). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is loaded from /app/frontend/.env via _load_base_url() helper. POS checkout flow: click Cobrar (main button) → dialog opens → click 'Cobrar' in dialog → ticket-dialog appears. WA phone auto-prefixes 52 (Mexico). Wa.me opens a popup — do NOT block on it, just verify POST /api/sales/{id}/ticket-pdf was called.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. All 5 features work as specified.
